risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantified metrics, but includes substantial boilerplate and extensive product-segment descriptions that dilute focus on financial risk. Revenue declined 13%, gross margin compressed, operating cash flow fell by $63.3 million, and results included a $59.8 million business-sale loss and $43.2 million of restructuring expense. Liquidity is described in general terms, with sensitivity to working capital, capital expenditures, debt payments, and other factors.
